label: measurement datum
definition: A measurement datum is an information content entity that is a recording of the output of a measurement such as produced by a device.
examples: Examples of measurement data are the recoding of the weight of a mouse as {40,mass,"grams"}, the recording of an observation of the behavior of the mouse {,process,"agitated"}, the recording of the expression level of a gene as measured through the process of microarray experiment {3.4,luminosity,}.
